tags.description: The Dindi Mill camping area is located at the old historical sawmill site. The mill had a large workforce, mostly of adult males with a few family groups. Remnants of the mill still remain such as the large sawdust heap. Small camping sites and a pit toil
tags.name: Dindi Mill
